environment.description: Same application container deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'app-input-sanitization' at priority 200 containing a single rule with a RegexPatternSet match on query string values matching pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|delete|update|insert)|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"]?\d|--\s*$|/\*.*\*/)` with BLOCK action and TextTransformation URL_DECODE followed by LOWERCASE, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 in BLOCK mode with no excluded rules. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm all three rule groups are actively evaluating. Additionally, the ALB access logs show the WAF evaluation header x-amzn-waf-action is populated on every request.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with HTTPS listener on 443
